Column 3: LANDING crouch. Hands down to catch the ground, head low, folded legs gather beneath the small torso, compact recovering posture. Different from takeoff, visibly absorbing impact. Down/front face readable, up/back face hidden, right side profile. Match head size, costume and lighting exactly across poses.
